mentions.h: BELS MISS THEIR CHANCE 4th in NATIONAL

mentions.note: Belgrave road runner described as a wine in a mock tasting-note team selection

photos.c: BACKPIECE PHOTOS: TOP LEFT: Barefooted Hart in the throes of a 9 miles battle with Dai Davies (TVH) who pipped him by one place. TOP RIGHT: Bicourt leads Ward (Man.DLC), Billings (Sutt.in A) and team-mate O'Hara. John finished one place ahead of Billings and 23 up on Ward. BOTTOM: A desperate North fights to hold off Bob Holt, Peter Welsh (Empire S'chase gold-medallist) and Mike Turner.
